title: Stardust enriched event
description: A usage event after Stardust Core has applied cost, the environmental methodology and the indicator code. Spec §5, §7, §8. Environmental fields are emitted as stardust.* OTel attributes (§11.2).

job_sji.description: Stardust Job Identifier: GUID shape with the 3-letter Energy Source Code in segment 2 (§5.3). Not an RFC 4122 UUID.

cost_usd.description: Null when the model has no known price.

particulate_mg.description: Not yet modeled in methodology v0.1.

ewaste_mg.description: Not yet modeled in methodology v0.1.

indicator_code.description: [Impact Grade][Cost Tier]-[Token Volume Class], e.g. B2-M (§5.1). Cost tier X = cost unknown (v0.1 extension).

energy_mix_breakdown.description: Grid-mix percentage split keyed by ESC, where known.

grid_diversified.description: True when the plurality source is below the diversification threshold (§5.3.3); display as "mixed grid".

methodology_version.description: Version of the factor configuration used, for auditability (§15).
